name: stepper
purpose: Progress indicator for multi-step flows rendered as navigation: a labelled <nav> with an ordered list of steps. Reachable steps are links (with an href) or buttons; the current step carries aria-current="step"; unreachable steps are text. Linear mode gates forward steps on consumer-owned completion status. Activation emits a cancelable aui-navigate, then aui-change.
whenToUse: Multi-step flows with a known, short sequence of steps, such as checkout, onboarding, or a setup wizard.
Showing which steps are complete, which step is current, and which are still ahead.
Letting users return to earlier steps (and, in non-linear flows, jump ahead).
whenNotToUse: Switching between peer views that have no order: use Tabs.
Showing where a page sits in a hierarchy: use Breadcrumb.
Reporting progress of a single task: use Progress Bar.
Flows with more than about 7 steps or with branching paths: split the flow or use a list of sections.
responsive: The host is an inline-size container. A horizontal stepper switches to the vertical layout when its own container is 30rem wide or narrower (container query, not the viewport). Labels and descriptions wrap and break anywhere; they never overflow the step.
rtl: Logical properties throughout: the horizontal step order and connectors follow the inline direction, and the vertical connector runs along the inline-start edge. direction: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the <nav>; otherwise the document direction is inherited.
theme: Current step: color-primary indicator border and number plus semibold label. Complete: filled color-primary indicator with a check icon and a color-primary connector to the next step. Error: color-error-fg indicator with an alert icon. States are also conveyed as text. Forced-colors mode draws indicators and connectors in CanvasText, the complete indicator in Highlight, and disabled steps in GrayText.
security: Labels and descriptions are rendered with textContent, never parsed as HTML. Each href is parsed with the URL standard against document.baseURI; only http(s) and scheme-less URLs are accepted, otherwise STEPPER_OPTIONS is thrown without echoing the value. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Step status is consumer-owned data; the stepper never infers completion.
limitations: Every change (activation, select, update, global configuration) rebuilds the step list; a step that had focus during update() or a configuration change loses focus.
After a link step is activated without preventDefault, focus is not moved; the page is expected to navigate.
The layout switch from horizontal to vertical is fixed at a 30rem container width.
No arrow-key navigation between steps; steps are separate Tab stops.
Step content (panels) is not rendered by the stepper; drive it from aui-change.
unsupported: Rendering HTML strings or custom nodes in labels or descriptions.
Hrefs with schemes other than http and https.
Automatic completion tracking (status is consumer data).
antiPatterns: Using a stepper as tabs for unordered content.
Marking steps complete before the user finished them, to unlock linear navigation.
Relying on color alone to show step status in custom styles (the built-in hidden status text must stay).
Ignoring aui-navigate when unsaved input on the current step must be validated first.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/stepper: generated AuiStepper directive ([auiStepper] on an empty host); inputs mirror the options, outputs auiNavigate and auiChange.
